name: elevique
description: Bulk video & image queue for Frameo.ai (Chrome extension, MV3).

scripts.build: rm -rf dist/extension && mkdir -p dist/extension && cp -R src/. public/. dist/extension/ && rm dist/extension/utils/*.test.js
